slides.content:
# Advanced Customization in Tailwind CSS ⚙️

While Tailwind includes an outstanding default design system, real-world apps require custom brand palettes, typography, bespoke plugins, and unique pixel values.

## What You'll Master in this Module:
- **tailwind.config.js Anatomy** — Core structure and options
- **Extending vs Overriding Themes** — Safely augmenting the defaults
- **Arbitrary Values & Modifiers** — `w-[350px]`, `bg-[#1da1f2]`
- **Arbitrary Properties & Variants** — `[mask-type:alpha]`
- **CSS Directives** — `@tailwind`, `@apply`, `@layer`
- **Official & Custom Plugins** — Extending compiler capabilities

slides.content:
# Arbitrary Values: Square Bracket Syntax `[...]` 🎯

When you need a one-off value that doesn't belong in your design system, use square bracket syntax.

## Examples of Arbitrary Values

| Utility | Arbitrary Example | Generated CSS |
|---|---|---|
| Dimensions | `w-[327px]` | `width: 327px;` |
| Colors | `bg-[#24292e]` | `background-color: #24292e;` |
| Grid Layout | `grid-cols-[200px_1fr_100px]` | `grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr 100px;` |
| Calc Expression | `top-[calc(100%-1.5rem)]` | `top: calc(100% - 1.5rem);` |
| Z-Index | `z-[9999]` | `z-index: 9999;` |

> ⚠️ **Syntax Note:** In arbitrary values, replace spaces with underscores `_`! E.g., `grid-cols-[1fr_2fr]` (never put raw spaces inside the brackets).

slides.content:
# The Official Tailwind Plugin Ecosystem 🌟

Tailwind Labs maintains four essential plugins for common development needs:

## 1. `@tailwindcss/forms`
Applies a clean, cross-browser reset to form controls that you can style with standard utilities:

```bash_not
npm install -D @tailwindcss/forms
```

## 2. `@tailwindcss/typography`
Provides the `prose` class for styling raw HTML/Markdown content.

## 3. `@tailwindcss/container-queries`
Enables styling based on parent container width instead of the viewport: `@container` and `@md:flex`.

## 4. `@tailwindcss/aspect-ratio`
Legacy aspect-ratio polyfill (modern Tailwind now uses native `aspect-*`).

slides.title: Container Queries: Beyond Viewport Breakpoints
slides.content:
# Modern Revolution: Container Queries 📦 With the `@tailwindcss/container-queries` plugin, components adapt to the width of **their immediate parent container**, not the entire browser window! ```html_not
Item A
Item B
Item C
``` > 💡 **Why This Is Huge:** Place this component in a narrow sidebar, and it renders as a column; place the exact same component in the main content area, and it renders as a 3-column grid!

slides.title: Debugging Tailwind & JIT Scanner Issues
slides.content:
# Debugging Tailwind Build Issues 🔍

## 1. Class Not Being Applied?
- Check `content` array in `tailwind.config.js`: is the file path covered?
- Make sure the class name is written as an unbroken string (no `${dynamic}` interpolation).
- Check browser inspector specificity: is a custom CSS rule overriding Tailwind's utility?

## 2. JIT Not Updating on Save?
- Ensure PostCSS watcher is running (`--watch` flag).
- Verify file extensions in `content` pattern (`{html,js,ts,jsx,tsx}`).

## 3. Large CSS File in Production?
- Verify that `NODE_ENV=production` is set so minification and purging occur.

slides.title: Summary of Tailwind CSS Course
slides.content:
# Tailwind CSS: Complete Course Summary 🎓

Congratulations! You have mastered the complete Tailwind CSS framework.

## What You Have Achieved:
- **Core Concepts**: Utility-first architecture, Preflight, mobile-first breakpoints, pseudo-classes, and dark mode.
- **Layout & Spacing**: Mastered Flexbox, CSS Grid, dimension scales, absolute/fixed positioning, and z-index.
- **Typography & Colors**: Fine-tuned font hierarchies, leading, tracking, curated 50-950 color ladders, and opacity modifiers.
- **Borders & Elevation**: Constructed radius curves, divide borders, ring outlines without layout shift, and glowing shadows.
- **Advanced Customization**: Configured `tailwind.config.js`, arbitrary values, `@layer` directives, and custom plugins.

You are now ready to build production-grade, stunning, responsive web apps with Tailwind CSS! 🚀

slides.title: Next Course: Sass Preprocessing
slides.content:
# What's Next: Sass (Syntactically Awesome Style Sheets) 💅

While Tailwind is utility-first, **Sass** remains the industry gold-standard CSS preprocessor for component-based CSS architectures.

## Up Next in Sass:
- **Variables & Nesting** with the `$` syntax and parent selector `&`
- **Modern Modular Architecture**: `@use`, `@forward`, and namespaces
- **Mixins & Functions**: Dynamic reusable style generators
- **Inheritance with `@extend`** and `%` placeholders
- **Control Directives**: `@if`, `@for`, `@each`, and `@while`

Let's master CSS preprocessing! 🚀
